Container.Name: Bloodborne-Private-Server
Container.Overview: Dedicated host for Bloodborne PC Seamless Co-op with automatic player IDs. Give players the Unraid LAN or host Tailscale IPv4 address. Use the matching Windows launcher release and keep the three default ports. Set up the appdata directory for UID 10001 and GID 10001 before starting.

Config.Name: Server data
Config.Description: Database, worlds, configuration, and link_key.bin. Keep this directory across updates. It must be writable by UID and GID 10001.

Config.Name: Seamless Co-op link
Config.Description: UDP relay for the Seamless Co-op game link. Keep the host port at 31314.

Config.Name: Web API
Config.Description: TCP port used by the game Web API. Keep the host port at 31315.

Config.Name: Bloodborne backend
Config.Description: TCP port used by the game backend. Keep the host port at 20443.

Config.Name: Backend advertised IPv4
Config.Description: Optional. Leave blank to use the IPv4 address the game connects to. Set to the Unraid LAN or host Tailscale IPv4 if you need to advertise a specific address.
